subject: Invoice sender + delivery preference: one-off emailed PDFs vs portal daily digest
messages:
From: Elaine Shaw <elaine.shaw@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Invoice delivery: do you send per-invoice PDF emails or a portal digest?

Hi Logan / Kimberly,

Quick question as we prepare to go live: who will be the invoice "sender" for Greenline? Our AP team prefers either (A) individual signed PDF invoices emailed to finance@greenlinehealth.com per invoice, or (B) a daily portal digest with downloadable PDFs and an SFTP bulk push for our ERP ingest.

We also need the VAT/Tax info to be present on the invoice (our EU entity needs VAT ID + reverse-charge note where applicable).

Attached is our PO and a sample of how our AP system parses incoming PDFs. Can you confirm which delivery option Redwood can support as standard, and whether we can enable both during the transition?

Thanks,
Elaine
Elaine Shaw
Head of Finance Operations
Greenline Health
Attachments: Greenline-signed-PO-77823.pdf, sample-invoice-spec.pdf

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Shaw <elaine.shaw@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery: do you send per-invoice PDF emails or a portal digest?

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clarity and the PO. Short answer: we can support both patterns but there are tradeoffs.

Option A — per-invoice emailed PDFs (default):
- Redwood will send a signed PDF for each invoice to finance@greenlinehealth.com as it is generated.
- Pros: immediate receipt, compatible with teams who rely on email-triggered parsing.
- Cons: more emails to manage; higher chance of duplicates if you also pull from portal.

Option B — portal daily digest + optional SFTP push to ERP:
- We can publish invoices to your Greenline portal account and also provide a daily digest email listing invoices with download links. For bulk ingest we offer an SFTP transfer of all PDFs at a configured cutoff time.
- Pros: single source of truth, easier reconciliation, lower email noise.
- Cons: requires AP to either use the portal or pick up the SFTP; some ERPs need mapping work.

VAT/Tax: we will include VAT ID fields and can render a reverse-charge line when you designate the billing entity. We also have a field for "tax evidence" that can carry your VAT certificate reference.

Can we do this: start with per-invoice emailed PDFs for the first 2 billing cycles while we set up your portal account and SFTP mapping? If that works, I will loop in Connor from onboarding to schedule the portal + SFTP cutover.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: sample-invoice-GLH-202602.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 13:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Fwd: Invoice delivery: do you send per-invoice PDF emails or a portal digest?

Looping Connor for onboarding scheduling + SFTP details. Notes / internal checklist below:

- Proposed path: 2-cycle email fallback -> enable portal (daily digest) -> SFTP at 23:00 UTC cutoff.
- Action: Connor to create portal account, invite Greenline AP, and generate SFTP credentials.
- Technical: SFTP payload = zipped PDFs + manifest.csv (invoice_id, date, amount, vat_id, pdf_name). We need mapping examples from their ERP; Elaine attached a sample.
- VAT: confirm billing entity EU vs US per invoice. Use "reverse charge" note when EU entity is buying from Redwood EU.

Connor — can you confirm estimated time to configure SFTP + portal invite? Also please prepare a short onboarding doc for Greenline AP that explains: how to download single invoices, how to consume the daily manifest, and how to opt out of email copies.

Thanks,
Kimberly
